name: @contractor/native-snapshot
description: Snapshot bootstrap, cursor persistence and tombstones (M03-T05): consistent server-state snapshot + watermark materialized in one transaction, bounded deterministic pagination, one-transaction client apply with durable cursor persistence, tombstones for deletes/scope changes, manifest-closure reconcile preserving pending local work, typed resync_required on expired cursors. Continues from the M03-T04 feed watermark. Evidence runs against real SQLite (node:sqlite).
